# Online Pujari
> Book verified pandits for puja, havan and sanskar at home or online in 147+ Indian cities, in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati and Malayalam. Muhurat is confirmed before you pay.
